extracted_facts_english:
Anthropic is investigating July incidents involving mistakenly enabled internet access in a third-party evaluation environment, plus a separate August evaluation incident. The affected evaluations ran without normal cyber safeguards.

The company paused external cyber evaluations and temporarily paused internal ones. It added a real-time classifier for attempted sandbox escapes and unexpected internet access, which blocks tool calls, terminates tasks and alerts a person. High-risk internal environments received stronger isolation; internal cyber evaluations resumed after these measures.

External evaluators testing pre-release models with reduced cyber safeguards must normally use hardened offline sandboxes, verify configurations, state allowed targets/actions/network boundaries and monitor continuously with termination on violations. These requirements are not announced as new conditions for ordinary customers using safeguarded models.
